Clearing the Camps#000.src: Talk to Captain Kymer outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Clearing the Camps#000.dst: Habla con el capitán Kymer a las afueras de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Clearing the Camps#001.src: Aha, another {p} soldier, eh? Well, a warm welcome to you.
Clearing the Camps#001.dst: Ajá, otro soldado de {p}, ¿eh? Bueno, te doy la bienvenida.
Clearing the Camps#001.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#002.src: Did you hear about the requests from the Villagers we've gotten? They say these "Orcs" and "Goblins" are threatening their towns and cities.
Clearing the Camps#002.dst: ¿Te has enterado de las peticiones que nos llegan de los aldeanos? Dicen que esos "orcos" y "goblins" amenazan sus pueblos y ciudades.
Clearing the Camps#002.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#003.src: Primitive, brutal creatures, apparently little better than the zombies we're used to, at least according to the {p} military.
Clearing the Camps#003.dst: Criaturas primitivas y brutales, poco mejores que los zombis a los que estamos acostumbrados, o eso dice el ejército de {p}.
Clearing the Camps#003.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#004.src: So, we figure if might makes right with them, then defeating their leaders should scare them into submission.
Clearing the Camps#004.dst: Suponemos que, si entre ellos manda la fuerza, derrotar a sus líderes bastará para someterlos por miedo.
Clearing the Camps#004.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#005.src: Our scouts have identified three "chief" orcs in the area- Elisu, Ceifko and Veltu. Though, strangely Veltu is always surrounded by goblins...
Clearing the Camps#005.dst: Nuestros exploradores han identificado a tres orcos "jefe" en la zona- Elisu, Ceifko y Veltu. Aunque, qué raro, a Veltu siempre lo rodean goblins...
Clearing the Camps#005.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#006.src: Well, whatever the case, we're needed to defend {p} here. Can you handle the chiefs? They seem to hide in the camps with green flags- search the plains, return once they're dealt with!
Clearing the Camps#006.dst: En fin, da igual: se nos necesita aquí, defendiendo {p}. ¿Te encargas tú de los jefes? Parecen esconderse en los campamentos con bandera verde- ¡busca en las llanuras y vuelve al acabar!
Clearing the Camps#006.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#007.src: Find and kill Orc Chieftains Elisu, Veltu, and Ceifko in the camps around {p}- look for green flags
Clearing the Camps#007.dst: Encuentra y mata a los jefes orcos Elisu, Veltu y Ceifko en los campamentos alrededor de {p}- busca las banderas verdes

Clearing the Camps#008.src: Report back to Captain Kymer once you have the three heads.
Clearing the Camps#008.dst: Vuelve con el capitán Kymer cuando tengas las tres cabezas.

Clearing the Camps#009.src: Ah, the soldier from earlier! You're back, I see. Any luck defeating those- ...yeesh. Are those their heads?
Clearing the Camps#009.dst: ¡Ah, el soldado de antes! Veo que has vuelto. ¿Pudiste acabar con esos- ...puaj. ¿Eso son sus cabezas?
Clearing the Camps#009.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#010.src: That's...harsher than I intended, but it works... Not like the Villagers care if they're dead of alive, as long as they're dealt with. I have your share of the reward here.
Clearing the Camps#010.dst: Es...más brutal de lo que pretendía, pero sirve... A los aldeanos les da igual si están vivos o muertos, con tal de resolverlo. Aquí tienes tu parte de la recompensa.
Clearing the Camps#010.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#011.src: This kind of surgical strike should help prevent an all-out war with the Orcs. Not sure we'd want a full-scale war to deal with in each province, hah!
Clearing the Camps#011.dst: Un golpe quirúrgico así debería evitar una guerra abierta con los orcos. ¡No nos conviene tener una guerra a gran escala en cada provincia, ja!
Clearing the Camps#011.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#012.src: You saw that the creatures in Gavel aren't akin to Wynnic fare while you were out, yes? They're a bit, ah...livelier than usual. Better get used to it.
Clearing the Camps#012.dst: Ahí fuera habrás visto que las criaturas de Gavel no son como las de Wynn, ¿no? Son un poco, ah...más vivas de lo normal. Ve acostumbrándote.
Clearing the Camps#012.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#013.src: The next major settlement is {p}, in the swamp up north, but I hear the swamp ogres are a lot tougher than the plains' fare. I'd stick around here and train up, first.
Clearing the Camps#013.dst: El siguiente pueblo grande es {p}, en el pantano del norte, pero dicen que los ogros de allí son mucho más duros que los de las llanuras. Yo me quedaría a entrenar aquí primero.
Clearing the Camps#013.speaker: Captain Kymer
